class FooTest {
    @Test
    void reads() throws Exception {
        try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream("a.txt")) {
            in.read();
        }
        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new FileReader("b.txt"))) {
            r.readLine();
        }
    }

    private FileInputStream open() throws Exception {
        return new FileInputStream("c.txt");
    }
}
